notes.title: Jack Barau on Steam Deck
notes.content:
We’re proud to announce that JACK BARAU is now playable on [b]Steam Deck[/b]!

It means a lot to us to bring this little adventure to a handheld format, and we’re truly happy to see Jack and his feathered friends playable anywhere — on the go, under a blanket, or even from a pirate ship (why not?).

Jack Barau is a cozy and meaningful journey, and we believe it fits perfectly in the palms of your hands.
Thank you for supporting the game — and the petrels. 🤍

See you soon on Deck!

[i]Petrels YEAH!!![/i]
